findings.description: The coordinator list claims to return the complete regional set, but a filter on a choice column plus region is not guaranteed delegable; past the delegation cap the gallery silently shows a partial set, so the result is wrong, not just slow.
findings.evidence: "The gallery shows the full set of matching events."

findings.description: The design mandates client-side encryption of every column before write, which Dataverse does not support and which would break server-side search, views, and plugins.
findings.evidence: The data model states "all columns are encrypted on the client before they are written to Dataverse", which is not a supported pattern.

findings.description: Unresolved placeholder / TBD in the document.

Non-manager restriction is described as a UI hide, not a data-layer control; a hidden control still returns rows to anyone who queries the table directly. Enforce with a security role or field-level security, not the client.
findings.evidence: "Access is hidden in the UI for non-managers."

findings.description: The approval threshold that gates submission is left unspecified, so the gate rule cannot be built or tested and downstream stages will guess at it.
Filtering a choice column by its localized label is fragile across languages and relabels and is typically non-delegable; compare the underlying choice value instead of the display text.
findings.evidence: "The status filter uses a text comparison on the status label so it reads naturally."

findings.description: Managers are granted read across every region with no stated need-to-know scoping; confirm cross-region visibility is actually required rather than assumed.
findings.evidence: The design says "Managers get a read only view across regions" without justifying the cross-region scope.
